findings.label: FACT
cells: Major
FACT: Serial PSRAM is claimed as supported, but there are no memory-mapped writes and CSN can stay low without limit, violating PSRAM tCEM
PSRAM được công bố là hỗ trợ, nhưng không có ghi memory-mapped và CSN có thể giữ mức thấp vô hạn, vi phạm tCEM của PSRAM
Either remove PSRAM from §1.1 and §2, or add memory-mapped write support plus a DLY-like maximum CSN-low counter that ends the frame at a byte boundary and restarts it.

findings.label: INFERENCE
cells: Major
§6.6.2, Table 6-14, Table 6-10, Table 8-3
INFERENCE: PRESCALER legality rules look stale after the V2.0 formula change: odd values are rejected in SDR and DDR allows only 2, 6, 10, ...
Quy tắc hợp lệ của PRESCALER có vẻ còn từ công thức cũ trước V2.0: giá trị lẻ bị từ chối ở SDR, DDR chỉ cho 2, 6, 10, ...

Accept every PRESCALER in SDR (1..255, 0 kept as F/2) and every even PRESCALER >= 2 in DDR (with the F-001 midpoint launch); update the TEF check in m_qspi_reg_cfg, Table 6-10, Table 6-14 and Table 8-3.

findings.label: FACT
cells: Observation
FACT: Abort raises CSN mid-byte without the CSN hold time and reports the same TCF as a normal completion
Abort kéo CSN lên giữa byte không có CSN hold time và báo cùng TCF như hoàn tất bình thường
Waive: Same behaviour as STM32 QUADSPI; software knows it issued the abort.

findings.label: FACT
cells: Major
§1.2, Table 7-3, Table 11-4 (ASM-003)
FACT: The AHB-Lite subordinate has no HREADY input and relies on the interconnect gating HSEL, a deviation from AMBA AHB (IHI 0033C)
AHB-Lite subordinate không có input HREADY và dựa vào interconnect để gate HSEL, lệch khỏi AMBA AHB (IHI 0033C)
Add input i_qspi_ahb_hready and accept an address phase only when HSEL & HREADY & HTRANS[1]; drop ASM-003 from Table 11-4.

findings.label: FACT
cells: Observation
FACT: The DMA req/clr handshake is custom and the target DMA controller is not named
Handshake DMA req/clr là tùy biến và DMA controller đích không được nêu
Waive: The handshake is fully specified and the integrator duty is in Table 11-4.

findings.label: INFERENCE
cells: Minor
Table 6-2 CDC-005 (ASM-007)
INFERENCE: DCR.FSIZE and the memory-mapped enable cross to HCLK through per-bit 2-flop synchronizers, safe only under a software rule
DCR.FSIZE và memory-mapped enable sang HCLK qua 2-flop synchronizer từng bit, chỉ an toàn nhờ quy tắc phần mềm

Carry FSIZE with the enable through a request/acknowledge handshake (data held in the clk domain, captured in HCLK on the synchronized toggle), or hold memory-mapped mode off in HCLK until the new FSIZE is stable.

findings.label: INFERENCE
cells: Minor
INFERENCE: Reset assumptions conflict and no RDC analysis is given for the four reset domains
Các giả định reset mâu thuẫn và không có phân tích RDC cho bốn reset domain
Add an RDC table: each crossing, its two resets, the state at release in each order, and why no spurious word or pulse is produced; reconcile ASM-002 with the core-in-reset sentences.

findings.label: FACT
cells: Observation
FACT: PARA_AHB_SYNC_FIFO_DEPTH sizes async FIFOs, and the IP subtracts base addresses that an interconnect normally removes
PARA_AHB_SYNC_FIFO_DEPTH thực chất là độ sâu async FIFO, và IP tự trừ base address vốn thường do interconnect xử lý
Waive: Defaults of 0 remove the subtractor's effect and the wrap case is documented.

findings.label: INFERENCE
cells: Blocker
INFERENCE: DDR output data changes on the same clk edge as every SCLK edge, so the flash sees zero hold time on address, alternate and data bits
Dữ liệu ra ở DDR đổi trạng thái cùng clk edge với mọi SCLK edge, flash nhận hold time bằng 0 cho address, alternate và data

In m_qspi_edge_sel add a DDR launch strobe at the middle of each SCLK half period (a quarter SCLK period after the edge) and use it to load the output register in DDR write phases; restrict DDR to an even PRESCALER >= 2 so the midpoint is an integer clk count; constrain the DDR falling edge in the SDC.

findings.label: FACT
cells: Major
FACT: Pad IO delays are 40 % placeholders of the fastest SCLK period and the DDR falling edge is unconstrained, so synthesis cannot reveal F-001 or F-002
IO delay của pad là placeholder 40 % chu kỳ SCLK nhanh nhất và cạnh xuống DDR không được constrain, nên synthesis không phát hiện được F-001, F-002

Write the pad budget from a named flash (tCLQV, tDS/tDH, tCSS/tCSH) plus pad and board delays; add set_output_delay -clock_fall for DDR; state the SCLK limit the budget closes for SDR read, SDR write and DDR.

findings.label: INFERENCE
cells: Minor
Table 11-3 EXC-001, EXC-002
INFERENCE: set_clock_groups -allow_paths is tool-specific and the Gray-pointer crossings have no skew constraint
set_clock_groups -allow_paths phụ thuộc tool và các crossing Gray pointer không có ràng buộc skew
State the STA tool; use set_max_delay -ignore_clock_latency (or -datapath_only) and add a skew constraint (set_data_check or set_bus_skew) on each Gray pointer bus.

findings.label: INFERENCE
cells: Major
INFERENCE: No area or power figure; the reviewer proxy is about 4.4k flops, with the TX/RX FIFOs about 46 % while the XIP cache is 8 words
Không có số liệu diện tích hay công suất; proxy của reviewer khoảng 4.4k flop, TX/RX FIFO chiếm khoảng 46 % trong khi cache XIP chỉ 8 word
Add an area/power table (proxy now, mapped with the UIT Tesla library later), allow synthesis clock-gating insertion, and reconsider 32-word FIFOs against a larger XIP cache for UIT Tesla.

findings.label: INFERENCE
cells: Major
INFERENCE: Read data is always captured half an SCLK period after the flash launch, with no sample shift or delay, so F/2 and probably F/4 reads cannot close
Dữ liệu đọc luôn được capture sau nửa chu kỳ SCLK, không có sample shift hay delay, nên đọc ở F/2 và có thể F/4 không đạt timing
Add a CR.SSHIFT-like field (or a 3-bit DCR sample-delay in clk cycles) that delays the sample strobe of read phases by 1..N clk cycles, and state the maximum read SCLK per delay setting in §6.6.2.

findings.label: INFERENCE
cells: Major
INFERENCE: The XIP cache is a single 32-byte stream buffer: every miss invalidates all lines, a NONSEQ miss fetches one word, HBURST is ignored and miss latency is not quantified
Cache XIP thực chất là một stream buffer 32 byte: mỗi miss invalidate toàn bộ line, miss NONSEQ chỉ fetch 1 word, bỏ qua HBURST, và latency miss không được định lượng

Fetch an aligned block (PARA_PREFETCH_LENGTH words) on every miss, NONSEQ included, using HBURST to size it; replace invalidate-all with a FIFO or LRU replacement of aligned blocks; add a latency table (hit, NONSEQ miss, SEQ miss) to §6.4.3.

findings.label: FACT
cells: Minor
FACT: Writes to BUSY-locked fields are silently dropped with no flag
Ghi vào field bị khóa khi BUSY bị bỏ qua âm thầm, không có flag
Add a sticky SR.WLKF (write-locked) flag, cleared through FCR, set when a write hits a BUSY-locked field.

findings.label: FACT
cells: Minor
FACT: DMA moves whole bursts only; the CPU must move the residue and a DMA channel programmed for it waits forever
DMA chỉ chuyển trọn burst; CPU phải chuyển phần dư và kênh DMA lập trình cho phần dư sẽ chờ mãi

Raise the request for the last partial burst when the remaining words are fewer than the threshold (TX: remaining bytes to write; RX: frame complete and RX FIFO not empty), with the DMA programmed by word count.

findings.label: INFERENCE
cells: Minor
INFERENCE: The DFT contract for the four clocks, four async resets and the pad capture flop is not written
Chưa viết DFT contract cho bốn clock, bốn async reset và flop capture của pad
Add a DFT table: reset controllability, clock sources in scan mode, synchronizer handling, pad IO in scan mode, expected coverage exclusions.

findings.label: FACT
cells: Minor
FACT: No APB timeout: an APB access while i_qspi_clk is stopped or in reset hangs the CPU bus
Không có APB timeout: truy cập APB khi i_qspi_clk dừng hoặc đang reset sẽ treo bus CPU
Waive: DEC-020 is a closed decision and the CRM rule in Table 11-4 removes the trigger.

findings.label: FACT
cells: Minor
FACT: No access control, register lock or integrity check on the boot/XIP path
Không có access control, khóa thanh ghi hay kiểm tra toàn vẹn trên đường boot/XIP
Waive: The exclusion is stated, and UIT Tesla states no secure-boot or untrusted-manager requirement.

findings.label: FACT
cells: Major
FACT: No requirement-to-test traceability, no coverage plan, no flash model named and no verification result; sim/ and lint/ are empty
Không có truy vết requirement-test, không có coverage plan, không nêu flash model và không có kết quả kiểm chứng; sim/ và lint/ trống

Give each §10 bullet a TEST-nnn ID mapped to REQ-nnn, name the flash model and require it to check tDS/tDH and tCLQV, list functional coverage bins, and add the regression status per configuration of Table 10-1.

findings.label: FACT
cells: Major
Table 6-1, Table 11-2, §9.6, Table 11-4
FACT: Clock frequencies conflict: all clocks are 200 MHz in Table 6-1/11-2, but §9.6 and Table 11-4 use HCLK = 100 MHz and i_qspi_clk = 5 MHz; PRESCALER <= 54 gives 108, not 110, clk cycles
Tần số clock mâu thuẫn: Table 6-1/11-2 ghi 200 MHz, nhưng §9.6 và Table 11-4 dùng HCLK = 100 MHz và i_qspi_clk = 5 MHz; PRESCALER <= 54 cho 108 chứ không phải 110 chu kỳ clk
State one UIT Tesla delivery clock plan, recompute the AHB timeout and the memory-mapped PRESCALER limit from it with the frame length used, and correct the 110/108 arithmetic.

findings.label: FACT
cells: Major
Table 1-1, §4, §5, §8, Appendix B
FACT: REF-002/006/008, the source design specification and 32 cited DEC/ASM/DEP items are not defined in the document; no requirement IDs; the review table is empty
REF-002/006/008, tài liệu design specification nguồn và 32 mục DEC/ASM/DEP được trích dẫn nhưng không định nghĩa trong tài liệu; không có requirement ID; bảng review trống
Add REF-002/006/008 and UIT-Tesla-QSPI-SPEC v0.2 to Table 1-1, append DEC/ASM/DEP tables with status and owner, add REQ-nnn IDs to normative statements, and set the title to V2.0.

findings.label: FACT
cells: Major
Table 11-4 (XIP bus row)
FACT: UIT Tesla provides an AXI XIP connection but the IP has an AHB-Lite port; the required bridge is not specified
UIT Tesla cung cấp kết nối XIP AXI nhưng IP chỉ có cổng AHB-Lite; bridge cần thiết chưa được đặc tả
Add a section that names the AXI-to-AHB-Lite bridge (or an AXI4 subordinate option), its owner, burst/WRAP conversion, response mapping, outstanding count and added latency.

findings.label: INFERENCE
cells: Observation
§8.2 Table 8-2, Table 8-3, Table 8-15
INFERENCE: Register offsets mirror STM32 QUADSPI but bit positions and PTR meaning differ, and its SSHIFT/DHQC timing features are absent
Offset thanh ghi giống STM32 QUADSPI nhưng vị trí bit và ý nghĩa PTR khác, và thiếu các tính năng timing SSHIFT/DHQC
State in §8 that the map is STM32-inspired but not compatible, list the differences, and adopt the sample-shift and DDR-hold fields of F-001/F-002.
